page.overview:
Who is Lrogg?

Lrogg is a fictional deity created by Ramsey Campbell for his short story "The Insects from Shaggai", which portrays it as the main god worshiped by the L'gy'hxians, the native inhabitants of the planet L'gy'hx, known to humans as Uranus.

In the role-playing game Call of Cthulhu, it is identified as an avatar of Nyarlathotep. (: Ye Booke of Monstres II)

Described as a "relatively insignificant deity" (compared to Azathoth), Lrogg is a two-headed bat-like creature worshiped as the main god on L'gy'hx. Its cult is regarded as comparatively agreeable, as Lrogg confers benefits to its believers and demands nothing more than an annual ritual that involves the removal of the limbs of a chosen native. Cultists are willing to tolerate other faiths, if not provoked. Their enemies are executed by having acid poured into their brains. The fact that these practices pale in comparison to the atrocities committed by the cult of Azathoth speaks volumes about the cruelty of the latter. (: "The Insects from Shaggai") Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Avatars of Nyarlathotep
